settings.lanIntro: Turn on LAN access below — until then, phones and tablets cannot use http://<this-PC-LAN-IP>:8766 (the server listens on this PC only). After enabling, open that URL from your tablet on the same Wi‑Fi. This app still uses 127.0.0.1 locally without a password. You may need an inbound Windows Firewall rule for TCP 8766. If this PC can open its own LAN IP but phones or tablets never load the page, that is almost always the Wi‑Fi/router: use the same network (not guest/IoT), turn off AP / client isolation if your router has it, and check both devices use the same subnet (e.g. 192.168.1.x). Some VPN or security suites block device-to-device traffic even when Windows Firewall is off.

setup.dedicatedJoinTitle: Dedicated server — join as client (no FTP)
setup.dedicatedJoinIntro: Preferred for most dedicated servers: the mod mirrors live data to a joined client PC. Use Local mode below — FTP is optional Advanced only.
setup.dedicatedJoinStep1: 1. Install the Farm Dashboard mod on the dedicated server.
setup.dedicatedJoinStep2: 2. On this PC (the one running Farm Dashboard), join that server as a client with the same mod enabled.
setup.dedicatedJoinStep3: 3. Join that server as a client with the same mod — export mirroring starts automatically when you join (no in-game switch). FTP remains Advanced for server hosts who have FTP access.
setup.dedicatedJoinStep4: 4. The client writes data.json under Documents\My Games\FarmingSimulator2025\modSettings\FS25_FarmDashboard\mirror_<slot>\ (separate from your local savegame folders so they never overwrite each other).
setup.dedicatedJoinStep5: 5. Add a Local PC server here (or Auto-Detect) and pick the mirror_* subfolder. No FTP required while someone is joined.
setup.dedicatedJoinLimits: Mirror needs at least one connected client with the mod. An empty dedicated server with zero players will not update until someone joins. Large exports may lag a few seconds behind the server. FTP remains Advanced for moderators with FTP access. Mirrored folders use a mirror_ prefix so they never conflict with single-player savegame slots on this PC.

rules.reason.limeBeforeSeedPF: pH is about {{ph}} vs ~{{target}} target — spread lime on prepared soil, then drill seed (not after seeding).
rules.reason.limeBeforeSeedNoPF: pH is below target for the next crop — lime before you drill or plant seed, so pH is right from emergence.
rules.reason.rollFirstStage: Rolling is not finished for this crop yet — roll once early for seed-to-soil contact and to press down small stones before later passes.
rules.reason.limeEmergedPF: {{label}}: pH ~{{ph}} vs target ~{{target}} — this is the tightest gap to fix first on the scan.
rules.reason.limeEmergedNoPF: {{label}}: pH is low — lime is the priority fix before chasing other passes.
rules.reason.weedsEarlyMechanical: Early growth (stage {{gs}}) — weeds are the worst issue for {{label}} right now; mechanical pass before herbicide.
rules.reason.weedsHerbicide: Growth stage {{gs}} — weed pressure on {{label}} is the priority pass now.
rules.reason.fertilizerPFGap: Mapped N {{n}} / {{target}} kg N/ha ({{pct}}% of target) — {{label}} is shortest on N versus the map; do this pass before other tweaks.
rules.reason.fertilizerSimple: {{label}} is lowest on fertilization for this stage — one nutrient pass is the next job.
rules.reason.pickStones: Stone level is up — walk the headlands slowly to spot rocks, then use a stone picker or collector on problem rows; a heavy roller can help sink small stones before drilling. Clear obstacles so drills and headers are not blocked.
rules.reason.finishFlaggedSoilWork: This field is still marked as needing work. Apply the highest-impact remaining pass first (lime, fertiliser, weed control, rolling, or ploughing), then recheck the card for the next step.
rules.reason.witheredGeneric: The standing crop has withered — till the soil and plant something new.
rules.reason.witheredCrop: Your {{label}} has withered — till the soil and plant something new.
rules.reason.grassReadyMow: Grass has reached cutting stage — bale silage/hay, wrap, or pick up before it gets rank.
rules.reason.combineHarvest: {{label}} is at harvest stage — get it off the field before rain, lodging, or withering costs yield.
rules.reason.cultivateCoverCrop: {{label}} is a catch/cover crop — cultivate (or direct-drill with tillage) to work it into the soil for a fertilisation boost. Do not combine-harvest it.
rules.reason.looseStrawField: Loose straw on the field — bale or collect before tillage or the next pass.
rules.reason.freshGrassWindrow: Fresh-cut grass on the field — tedder or bale before the next stage.
rules.reason.hayWindrowField: Hay is on the field — bale or collect before the next stage.
rules.reason.allWindrowsField: Loose straw, grass, and hay are on the ground — clear forage before continuing.
rules.reason.strawGrassWindrows: Loose straw and grass are on the field — bale or collect before continuing.
rules.reason.strawHayField: Straw and hay on the field — bale or collect before continuing.
rules.reason.grassHayWindrows: Grass and hay are on the field — finish before the next stage.
rules.reason.looseForageGeneric: Loose forage material detected — bale or collect before the next field stage.
rules.reason.looseStrawGround: Loose straw on the ground — bale or collect before tillage or the next pass.
rules.reason.grassWindrowField: Grass is lying on the field — tedder or bale before the next stage.
rules.reason.hayWindrowSimple: Hay is on the field — bale or collect before the next stage.
rules.reason.multipleWindrows: Multiple forage types are lying on the field — clear them before the next stage.
rules.reason.strawDensityMap: Loose straw is on the field (density map) — bale or collect before tillage or the next crop.
rules.reason.strawCerealResidue: Loose straw or cereal residue is on the field — clear it so cultivation and the next crop aren’t blocked.
rules.reason.dryHayWindrow: Hay is on the ground — finish tedding if needed, then bale or store before rain.
rules.reason.freshGrassCut: Fresh-cut grass is still on the ground — dry/ted for hay, or bale for silage (wrap wet bales) before you till.
rules.reason.cropSwath: Crop windrows are on the field — combine pick-up, baler, or loader work before you work the soil.
rules.reason.strawCerealLying: Loose straw is lying on the field — clear it so cultivation and the next crop aren’t blocked.
rules.reason.swathCovering: Windrow or swath is covering the soil — remove it before you work ground for the next pass.
rules.reason.oneBale: There is 1 bale still on this farmland — clear it so cultivators and planters aren’t blocked.
rules.reason.manyBales: There are {{n}} bales still on this farmland — load or stack them out of the way before tillage or drilling.
rules.reason.runSoilScan: Scan data is needed before pH, nitrogen maps, and drilling advice match this parcel.
rules.reason.mulchBeforePlough: Field data says this parcel still needs ploughing — shred harvest residue first (not for grass reseeding).
rules.reason.ploughDeep: Primary tillage is still due on this parcel before you can build a clean seedbed — invert or loosen soil deep enough for your next crop.
rules.reason.cultivateMulch: Stubble is mulched — mix it in for an even seedbed. Lime (if needed) should already be planned before seed.
rules.reason.buildSoilNPF: Target ~{{target}} kg N/ha — you’re near {{n}}; add organic first if you use it, then mineral.
rules.reason.fertilizeForDrilling: Spray / nutrient step isn’t full — build N after lime, before you drill seed (or in an early pass right after drilling if that’s your routine).
rules.reason.optionalOrganicFirst: Use slurry/manure now if that is your route. If not, skip this optional step for this field cycle.
rules.reason.directDrillMulched: With Precision Farming on, this parcel is ready to plant — one pass with the drill through mulch/residue is the next job.
rules.reason.directDrillBare: With Precision Farming on, this parcel is ready to plant — one pass with the drill is the next job; skip extra cultivation if your setup allows.
rules.reason.sowPlant: Soil prep for this field is satisfied for drilling — the next job is putting seed in.
rules.reason.directDrillNoCrop: Precision Farming is on and there’s no standing crop — the next job is planting with a direct drill; skip a full cultivation pass if your setup allows.
rules.reason.cultivateMulchedDrill: Stubble is mulched and there’s no active crop — shallow cultivation before drilling is the usual path without Precision Farming maps guiding no-till.
rules.reason.mulchPostHarvest: Harvest residue is still standing and primary tillage is due — shred stubble so the plough or deep cultivator can work cleanly.
rules.reason.ploughBeforeNextCrop: Precision Farming is enabled and this parcel still needs full inversion or deep tillage — maps and flags say ploughing isn’t satisfied yet.
rules.reason.directDrillPostHarvest: Precision Farming is on and ploughing isn’t flagged — harvest is done, so the next job is planting with a direct drill and keeping tillage minimal.
rules.reason.ploughThenSeedbed: Harvest is done and the save still flags primary tillage — work the soil deep, then cultivate and drill (or follow your rotation’s cultivation step).
rules.reason.cultivateStubbleDrill: Harvest is done and ploughing isn’t flagged — shallow cultivation before the next seeding matches this field state (use in-game no-till if you prefer).
rules.reason.limePastureMapPF: Mapped pH ~{{ph}} vs target ~{{target}} — grass tolerates a wider band than arable; lime after cuts only when the scan says pH is short, not as a drill-window task.
rules.reason.checkPasturePH: Low lime flags on permanent grass often follow mowing — correct pH gradually; avoid treating pasture like pre-drill arable land.
rules.reason.buildSoilNTilled: Target ~{{target}} kg N/ha — you’re near {{n}}; finish after lime, before seed.
rules.reason.fertilizeTilledSimple: Bring spray/N up after lime and before drilling seed.
rules.reason.sowSeedbed: Ground reads cultivated/plowed with no crop — drill seed only after any required lime and starter N prep for this field.
rules.reason.prepareDrill: Field reads empty — plough/cultivate as needed, then put a crop in.
rules.reason.fallback: The offline rules don’t match this odd state — use in-game field hints or the live suggestions list from your save.

companions.desc.seasonalWoolProduction: Shears sheep twice a year and charges a fee per sheep. FarmHub reads the shearing month, fee, and tracked pens, not each animal's health.
companions.desc.taskList: Tracks due work for the current farm. FarmHub lists active tasks for that farm and does not change them.
companions.desc.productionSchedule: Turns recipes on only in chosen months. FarmHub reads that schedule for the current farm. A paused month is a plan, not a breakdown.
companions.desc.economicHistory: Keeps monthly income and cost history per farm. FarmHub reads that farm's totals, balance, and loan balance, not another farm's ledger.

companions.desc.animalPlanner: Compares a barn's current herd with its capacity. FarmHub reads the animal count for this farm and does not copy the planner's internal objects.
companions.desc.vipOrderManager: Single-player VIP orders. FarmHub reads how many are open and the current order's items left and payout. It does not pay them out or export their goods.
companions.desc.fieldProfitabilityLedger: Single player only. FarmHub reads this farm's field cycles and the ledger's own category totals through its summary query. Estimates are labelled as estimates. The ledger has no sale category, so sales are not shown.
companions.desc.farmReputation: Stores contract reputation per farm. FarmHub reads this farm's score and rank limits and does not add or remove reputation.
companions.live.reputationEmpty: No reputation stored for this farm.
companions.desc.yieldTracker: Records harvest amounts by field. FarmHub reads the stored rows in single player and does not load or save the yield file.
companions.desc.moistureSystem: Adds moisture to fields, piles, bales and silos, with grades and drying. FarmHub reads the map moisture, crop windows and the in-game forecast, plus this farm's silos, bales and irrigation bookings.
companions.desc.fieldLeasing: Lease farmland instead of buying it. FarmHub reads this farm's leases, the mod's price factor and minimum term, and the lease charges in your finances.
companions.desc.rentYourField: Rents your own fields out. FarmHub reads this farm's agreements and does not start or end a rental.
companions.live.rentEmpty: No fields rented out by this farm.
companions.desc.distributionRedux: Replaces production distribution. FarmHub reads the save-wide mode, buffer and selling switch, plus this farm's overrides and last-hour moves, and does not apply routes.
companions.desc.silageCompactionMonitor: Shows a compaction HUD while you drive on a bunker. FarmHub copies that HUD's compaction line and time estimate in single player while it is showing. Bunker fill, compaction and fermentation for every bunker are on the native storage page.
companions.live.silageEmpty: No compaction HUD text for this farm.
companions.desc.farmOperationsDashboard: Another overview of fields, animals, and productions. FarmHub shows its own overview counts for this farm next to the mod's cached field HUD rows and does not copy that screen.

companions.desc.enhancedLoanSystem: Replaces vanilla farm credit with annuity loans: fixed amount, term, and interest, with monthly installments and collateral based on vehicles, land, and cash. Interest can float month to month.
companions.desc.automaticLoanRepay: Automatically pays down outstanding farm loans at a chosen in-game hour while keeping a minimum cash balance.
companions.desc.iNeedALoan: Adds a clearer loan request flow and shopping helpers when you need extra credit for purchases.
companions.desc.noCredit: Disables taking new farm loans so you play cash-only (existing debt may still apply depending on setup).
companions.desc.realisticDieselPrice: Sets diesel price from real-world country presets via the game settings menu. Tank fill can cost more than station fuel; multiplayer supported.
companions.desc.fluctuatingDieselPrice: Moves diesel price over time with the economy difficulty and in-game clock instead of a fixed country rate.
companions.desc.dynamicMarket: Selling-station prices move by market group each period with season, weather, supply and demand, and big sales push one station's price down for a while. FarmHub shows the group moves, seasonal price curves and station sell pressure on its own page, and never changes prices.
companions.desc.marketPriceHelper: Adds in-game helpers and tickers so you can spot strong sell prices without opening every station.
companions.desc.enhancedSeasonalPrices: Changes buying prices as well as selling prices, and needs the Seasonal Prices base package. FarmHub does not read those prices from this mod.
companions.desc.statisticsExtended: Expands the in-game statistics screens with extra farm performance detail.
companions.desc.restrictedPeriods: Blocks spreading slurry, digestate, and manure during closed seasons (and frost for liquids), matching fertilizer ordinance-style rules.
companions.desc.regionalCropCalendar: Applies a regional planting/harvest calendar with optional weather and yield profiles instead of the vanilla global calendar.
companions.desc.soilWorkYieldBonus: Pays a yield bonus on soil you have worked until it is harvested. FarmHub reads the mod's tool bonuses and totals the worked ground waiting for harvest (the mod keeps one grid for the whole map).
companions.desc.smartCropControl: Controls selected NPC crop allocation by field size and category. It does not plan the player's own crops.
companions.desc.dynamicFieldPrices: Makes farmland buy prices move with demand and ownership instead of static PDA prices.
companions.desc.farmlandMarketplace: Lists farmland sale and lease offers between farms. FarmHub reads this farm's rows and does not accept or withdraw them.
companions.live.marketEmpty: No marketplace rows for this farm.
companions.desc.betterContracts: Improves contract generation, filtering, and NPC behaviour so missions stay useful longer into a save.
companions.desc.missionsExpanded: Adds extra mission variety and contract options on top of the vanilla mission manager.
companions.desc.additionalContracts: Registers extra contract types (often pairs with Better Contracts) for more fieldwork variety.
companions.desc.livestockMonitor: In-game husbandry overview with HUD and alert modes. FarmHub reads the display mode and refresh time, and counts alerts on this PC's screen for your farm. Barn stats stay on the Pastures page.
companions.desc.animalFoodOverview: Explains animal feed groups and the foods each group accepts. Barn stock levels are a separate reading.
companions.desc.animalFoodCalculator: Scales animal food, water, and straw use. FarmHub reads the mode, the scales, and days per period. It does not apply that scale again to barn stocks.
companions.desc.realisticAnimalLosses: Animals can die or leave when care is neglected — health, food, and housing matter more.
companions.desc.realisticMilkingTimes: Restricts milking to realistic windows instead of continuous dairy output.
companions.desc.seasonalMilkProduction: Scales milk output with the season. FarmHub reads the current period factor and does not change the barn.
companions.desc.animalTrader: A placeable animal business with its own buying, selling, and rent rules. Animal and money totals stay on the existing farm pages.
companions.desc.stallRental: Pays boarding income for qualifying healthy horses in your stalls. The useful figures are eligible horses and income, not a rent bill for stall space.
companions.desc.productionWatcher: In-game alerts when production inputs run low or outputs fill up. The mod keeps its alert list private, so FarmHub applies the same rules to your farm's productions.
companions.desc.productionControl: Adjusts production speed from 50% to 300%, which also changes operating cost. FarmHub does not yet read that speed.
companions.desc.productionsManager: Manager UI for surveying recipes, fill levels, and status across all owned productions.
companions.desc.factoryProfitCalculator: Estimates each production line's monthly profit. FarmHub uses the mod's month basis and price helpers for this farm's lines and never calls the mod's production list, which writes onto the production point.
companions.desc.timeSavingStockCheck: Adds an in-game menu page listing your stored products, where each sells best today and which month pays the most.
companions.desc.palletDegradation: Pallets can lose condition over time. FarmHub reads this farm's pallet condition and does not apply wear.
companions.live.palletEmpty: No pallet condition records for this farm.
companions.desc.realSilo: Splits silo storage into compartments. FarmHub reads this farm's compartment levels and does not change the layout.
companions.live.siloEmpty: No compartment silos for this farm.
companions.desc.advancedMaintenance: Worn machines can stall at random above about 29 % damage and will not start at 100 %. FarmHub shows each machine's zone and the mod's stall odds, and never rolls the check.
companions.desc.extendedVehicleMaintenan: Tracks service time and faults on its own. FarmHub reads this farm's service fields and does not start a workshop job.
companions.desc.realisticVehicleService: Tracks faults, warm-up, and the key. FarmHub reads the stored state and does not repair, tow, or turn the key.
companions.desc.outOfFuel: Removes the automatic safety fuel top-up when a save loads. Dashboard fuel warnings are the game's own fuel reading, not this mod.
companions.desc.puncturedTires: Up to two random punctures a year. A punctured vehicle is held to walking speed until you pay for the repair. FarmHub shows the year's schedule and each vehicle's tyres.
companions.desc.collisionDamage: Adds wear damage when a vehicle suddenly loses speed in a collision, scaled by a multiplier in the game settings. FarmHub shows the settings and this session's hits.
companions.desc.vehicleMileage: Tracks odometer and trip distance on vehicles for service and usage history.
companions.desc.implementUsageCounter: Counts implement operating use so you know which tools have worked the hardest.
companions.desc.ingameTimeOperatingHours: Scales operating hours and fuel use with game time. It does not only change the hours label.
companions.desc.saveUnitProfiles: Saves unit and currency settings per savegame. FarmHub shows the active profile and the game's money setting. Amounts follow the save's unit display.
companions.desc.imperialSystem: Switches liquids to US gallons, grain to bushels, solids and weights to pounds or US tons, and lengths to feet. FarmHub follows its fill-unit choices.
companions.desc.britishFillUnits: Shows solid fill amounts by weight (kg, then tonnes) and their prices per tonne. Liquids stay in litres. FarmHub follows it for fill amounts.
companions.desc.bushelPlus: A loss-measurement pan for the back of a combine that raises the combine's threshing yield while attached. FarmHub lists your units and which combines carry one.

companionPage.enhancedLoanSystem.lead: Enhanced Loan System replaces the bank's single credit line with annuity loans: each loan has its own rate and term and is paid monthly. This page lists your open loans, what they still cost and how much more the bank will lend.

companionPage.enhancedLoanSystem.look2: Payments are taken at each month change; keep enough cash on hand.
companionPage.enhancedLoanSystem.look3: Selling vehicles or land lowers your collateral and so the amount you can borrow.
companionPage.iNeedALoan.setBuffer: Extra buffer on top of the price
companionPage.iNeedALoan.lead: I Need A Loan offers to borrow the shortfall when you buy something you cannot afford, in steps of the bank's loan size. This page shows how much credit is left and where the offer pops up.

companionPage.iNeedALoan.look3: Each offer can be switched off in the game's settings menu.

companionPage.automaticLoanRepay.look2: A notification appears when a repayment is made.
companionPage.automaticLoanRepay.look3: It runs once per month; if you are short that month, it waits until the next.
companionPage.realisticDieselPrice.lead: Realistic Diesel Price fixes the diesel price to a real-world country average or your own custom price. This page shows the price the game is charging and the presets you can choose from.

replicaLink.title: Link this server?
replicaLink.intro: You joined a multiplayer server. Farm Dashboard stores nothing from it on this PC until you link it.
replicaLink.renewNote: Once linked, later joins to this server reconnect automatically after the server proves it is the same one. A different server asks again.
replicaLink.linked: Server linked. Its data appears in a few seconds.
replicaLink.errorRecoveryRequired: The saved server list needs repair before another server can be linked. Open Settings, Servers.
replicaLink.errorChanged: The game moved to a different server or save. Check the new request.
replicaLink.errorLinkLimit: This PC already has {{count}} linked multiplayer servers. Remove one in Settings, Servers, then link this one.
replicaLink.invalid: The game's link request could not be read safely, so nothing was stored. Leave and rejoin the server to try again.
replicaLink.badgeHint: Copy received from a server you joined, not the server's own files.
replicaLink.restoreIntro: This PC has a retained multiplayer link, but its dashboard source is missing. First prove the link from the currently loaded game, then confirm restoration.
replicaLink.restoreNote: Load the linked multiplayer save in Farming Simulator, then start the fresh in-game check. No dashboard source is restored until you confirm a valid proof.
replicaLink.recoveryCancelFailed: The previous in-game check could not be cancelled. Retry here before starting another check; no source has been restored.
replicaLink.recoveryWaiting: Waiting for the loaded game to prove this link. Keep the multiplayer save open.
replicaLink.recoveryVerified: The loaded game proved this link. Confirm to restore the original source and save slot.
replicaLink.recoveryProofFailed: The in-game proof did not match this saved link. Nothing was restored. Check the server and try again.
